rules.requirement: Keep company sign-in and pilot-group access enabled for staff demos.

rules.requirement: Private service credentials stay in approved server-side storage; client-safe publishable keys are a different class.
rules.why: Browser code can be inspected by anyone who loads it.
rules.next_step: Read the existing named secret setting from the server without printing its value.
